title: Diet, Economic Development, and Climate Change
abstract: We develop a quantitative, multi-country general equilibrium framework to study the impact of economic growth, dietary restrictions and food trade policies on global greenhouse-gas (GHG) emissions from agriculture. Motivated by new cross-country relationships between economic development, diet patterns, agricultural technologies and GHG emissions, our framework features different income elasticities of demand across food products and multiple agricultural technologies for production across grid cells covering the surface of the Earth, with food products and technologies being heterogeneous in their GHG emissions per calorie. Using our model’s open-economy structure, we propose a simple procedure to estimate the income elasticities without price data. We find that GHG emissions following economic growth are strongly influenced by general equilibrium effects related to dietary changes, agricultural modernisation and food supply readjustments. Moreover, compared with food trade policies, dietary restrictions are both substantially more effective in reducing GHG emissions and more favourable when considering the welfare losses in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个定量的多国一般均衡框架，用以研究经济增长、饮食限制和粮食贸易政策对农业领域全球温室气体（GHG）排放的影响。受经济发展、饮食结构、农业技术与温室气体排放之间新的跨国关系启发，我们的框架设定了不同食品在需求上具有不同的收入弹性，并在覆盖地球表面的网格单元中引入多种农业生产技术，各类食品和技术每单位热量的温室气体排放各不相同。利用模型的开放经济结构，我们提出一种无需价格数据即可估计收入弹性的简单方法。我们发现，经济增长之后的温室气体排放受到与饮食变化、农业现代化和粮食供给调整相关的一般均衡效应的强烈影响。此外，与粮食贸易政策相比，饮食限制在减少温室气体排放方面要有效得多，并且在考虑发展中国家的福利损失时也更为有利。

title: Scaling Up Agricultural Insurance
abstract: We study the general equilibrium effects of scaling up rainfall insurance in low-income agricultural economies. Microeconomic experiments show that risk is an important constraint for farmers in developing countries and that rainfall insurance increases investment and shifts crop choice toward riskier, higher-return crops. We develop a model of farmer-households and insurance to quantify these effects. We derive a sufficient-statistics characterization of the optimal subsidy, which trades off three terms: a fiscal externality from subsidizing insurance below cost, a pecuniary externality that captures how crop-price changes reallocate consumption across states of the world, and a fiscal incidence term that captures how the subsidy transfers resources from those who do not buy insurance towards those who do. We calibrate the model to Ghana's agricultural economy, combining experimental moments from the literature with additional moments from household survey data. Subsidizing insurance leads to increased insurance take-up, fertilizer use, and agricultural output, and general equilibrium forces significantly amplify these effects. However, we find that the optimal insurance subsidy is close to zero.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在低收入农业经济体中扩大降雨保险规模所产生的一般均衡效应。微观经济实验表明，风险是发展中国家农民的重要约束，降雨保险会增加投资，并使作物选择转向风险更高、回报更高的作物。我们构建了一个包含农户家庭与保险的模型，以量化这些效应。我们推导出最优补贴的充分统计量表达式，它权衡了三项因素：低于成本补贴保险所带来的财政外部性；刻画作物价格变化如何在不同自然状态之间重新配置消费的金钱外部性；以及补贴将资源从未购买保险者转移给购买保险者所产生的财政归宿项。我们以加纳的农业经济对模型进行校准，将文献中的实验矩与家庭调查数据提供的额外矩相结合。补贴保险会提高保险参保率、化肥使用量和农业产出，而一般均衡力量显著放大了这些效应。然而，我们发现最优保险补贴接近于零。

title: Public R&D Meets Economic Development: Embrapa and Brazil's Agricultural Revolution
abstract: Can public R&D in developing countries raise productivity? We study how Brazil’s Embrapa—a public research corporation founded in 1973 to develop locally-relevant agricultural technologies—shaped agricultural development. Researcher-level micro-data reveal that Embrapa shifted innovation toward staple crops and Brazil-specific ecology, with no decline in researcher productivity. Exploiting Embrapa’s staggered expansion alongside municipality-level variation in the ecological suitability of Em-brapa’s innovation, we find significant increases in agricultural productivity, concen-trated in targeted staple crops. Our estimates imply that Embrapa raised aggregate agricultural productivity by 110% with a benefit–cost ratio of 17, driven by the appli-cability of Embrapa’s innovation across Brazil. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的公共研发投入能否提高生产率？我们研究了巴西国家农业研究公司（Embrapa，即巴西农业研究院）的作用。该公司成立于1973年，旨在开发适应本地条件的农业技术，我们考察了它如何塑造巴西的农业发展。研究人员层面的微观数据显示，Embrapa将创新转向主要粮食作物和巴西特有的生态环境，同时研究人员的生产率并未下降。利用Embrapa交错式的扩张，并结合各市层面Embrapa创新在生态适宜性上的差异，我们发现农业生产率显著提高，且集中于重点粮食作物。我们的估计表明，Embrapa将农业总生产率提高了110%，效益成本比为17，其驱动因素在于Embrapa的创新可在巴西各地广泛适用。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家的居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Farm Size Distribution, Weather Shocks, and Agricultural Productivity
abstract: This paper studies the dynamics of farm size distribution, how they are influenced by weather shocks, and the implications for aggregate productivity. Using data from several developing countries, we first document new empirical facts about households' landholding choices and how weather shocks influence these decisions. Building on a rich longitudinal dataset for Colombia on farm sizes, land transactions, and households' consumption and investment decisions, we then show that weather shocks increase the frequency of land sales and reduce farm sizes within municipalities, especially among smaller farms. To rationalize these facts, we develop a dynamic, heterogeneous household model in which uninsured farmers make landholding and occupational choices. Our calibrated model shows that uninsured risk substantially curbs aggregate agricultural productivity, and that the effects of temporary weather shocks on farm size and agricultural output are highly persistent, taking more than a decade to fade out.
abstract_zh: 本文研究农场规模分布的动态变化、天气冲击如何影响这一分布，以及其对总体生产率的含义。利用若干发展中国家的数据，我们首先记录了家庭土地持有选择的新实证事实，以及天气冲击如何影响这些决策。基于哥伦比亚一个丰富的纵向数据集（涵盖农场规模、土地交易以及家庭消费和投资决策），我们随后表明，天气冲击会增加土地出售的频率，并在市县内减小农场规模，尤其是小农场。为解释这些事实，我们构建了一个动态的异质性家庭模型，在其中没有保险的农民需要做出土地持有和职业选择。校准后的模型表明，无保险风险显著抑制了总体农业生产率，且暂时性天气冲击对农场规模和农业产出的影响高度持久，需要十多年才能消退。

title: Migration, Specialization, and Trade: Evidence from Brazil's March to the West
abstract: We study how migration shapes aggregate and regional comparative advantage, exploiting a large migration of farmers to Brazil’s West between 1950 and 2010. Migration allowed workers to sort according to their own comparative advantage, reallocating knowledge and raw labor to high-productivity regions. In a quantitative model, we find that migration cost reductions reshaped Brazil’s comparative advantage and contributed to its rise as a leading commodity exporter—accounting for 25% of the observed changes in specialization. Road expansions were key drivers of migration. Migration opportunities, moreover, account for a substantial share of the gains from trade.
abstract_zh: 我们研究移民如何塑造总体和区域比较优势，利用了1950至2010年间大规模农民向巴西西部迁移这一事件。移民使劳动者能够依据自身的比较优势进行分类配置，将知识和普通劳动力重新分配到高生产率地区。在一个定量模型中，我们发现移民成本的降低重塑了巴西的比较优势，并促成其成长为主要商品出口国，解释了所观察到的专业化变化中的25%。道路扩张是移民的关键驱动因素。此外，移民机会在贸易收益中占相当大的份额。

title: Deforestation: A Global and Dynamic Perspective
abstract: We study deforestation in a dynamic world trade system. We first document that between 1990-2020: (i) global forest area has decreased by 7.1 percent, with large heterogeneity across countries, (ii) deforestation is associated with expansions of agricultural land use, (iii) deforestation is larger in countries with a comparative advantage in agriculture, and (iv) population growth causes deforestation. Motivated by these facts, we build a model in which structural change and comparative advantage determine the extent, location, and timing of deforestation. Using the model, we obtain conditions under which reductions in trade costs and tariffs reduce global deforestation. Quantitatively, eliminating global agricultural tariffs has limited impacts on global forest area, leads to substantial forest reallocation across countries, and results in net welfare benefits Farid Farrokhi Boston College
abstract_zh: 我们在一个动态的世界贸易体系中研究森林砍伐问题。我们首先记录了1990至2020年间的以下事实：(i) 全球森林面积减少了7.1%，且各国差异巨大；(ii) 森林砍伐与农业用地扩张相关；(iii) 在农业具有比较优势的国家，森林砍伐更为严重；(iv) 人口增长导致森林砍伐。基于这些事实，我们构建了一个模型，其中结构转型和比较优势决定了森林砍伐的规模、位置和时机。利用该模型，我们得到了贸易成本和关税降低会减少全球森林砍伐的条件。在定量层面，取消全球农产品关税对全球森林面积的影响有限，但会导致森林资源在各国之间大幅重新配置，并带来净福利收益。法里德·法罗基（Farid Farrokhi），波士顿学院

title: Trade and Technology Adoption in Distorted Economies
abstract: This paper examines how labor market imperfections distort firm-level technology choices and alter the gains from trade in developing countries. Motivated by evidence that firms using modern technologies are disproportionately exposed to labor market distortions, we introduce firm-level technology choices and labor market distortions into an otherwise standard quantitative trade model. We then provide formulas for the welfare and labor productivity gains from trade liberalization, highlighting the role of distortions and technology choice. Our quantitative analysis reveals that labor market distortions provide a possible explanation for the inefficiently low levels of modern technology adoption in developing countries. Moreover, labor market distortions erode one-third of the potential labor productivity gains from trade liberalization among low-income countries.

title: Irrigation and the Spatial Pattern of Local Development in India
abstract: We study the long-term impact of large-scale irrigation infrastructure on the composition of local economic activity in India. Our analysis uses high-resolution spatial data covering approximately 150,000 villages and towns and exploits spatial discontinuities in the coverage of irrigation projects. Irrigation increases agricultural output, wealth, and population density in rural villages. However, in towns it reduces population and nightlight density, the size of the non-agricultural sector, and large-firm activity. These results highlight the heterogeneous impacts that agricultural productivity gains can have on the patterns local economic development.
abstract_zh: 我们研究大规模灌溉基础设施对印度地方经济活动构成的长期影响。我们的分析使用覆盖约15万个村庄和城镇的高分辨率空间数据，并利用灌溉项目覆盖范围中的空间断点。灌溉提高了农村村庄的农业产出、财富和人口密度。然而，在城镇中，灌溉却减少了人口和夜间灯光密度、非农部门的规模以及大企业的活动。这些结果凸显了农业生产率提升对地方经济发展格局可能产生的异质性影响。

title: Trade, Technology, and Agricultural Productivity
abstract: We examine the contribution of trade to the rise of modern agriculture, taking into account interactions between trade, input requirements, and technology adoption. We develop and estimate a new multicountry general equilibrium model that incorporates producers’ choices of which crops to produce and with which technologies at the level of grid cells covering the earth’s surface. We find that trade cost reductions in agricultural inputs and the international transmission of productivity growth in the agricultural input sector since the 1980s induced large shifts from traditional, labor-intensive technologies to modern, input-intensive ones, with important global and distributional implications for productivity and welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了贸易对现代农业兴起的贡献，同时兼顾贸易、投入品需求与技术采纳之间的相互作用。我们构建并估计了一个新的多国一般均衡模型，该模型在覆盖地球表面的网格单元层面刻画生产者对种植作物种类及所用技术的选择。我们发现，自20世纪80年代以来，农业投入品贸易成本的下降以及农业投入品部门生产率增长的国际传导，诱发了从传统劳动密集型技术向投入密集型现代技术的大规模转变，并对全球生产率、福利及其分配产生了重要影响。

title: From Bilateral to Centralized Markets: A Search Model for Commodity Exchanges in Africa
abstract: Several African countries have recently centralized their agricultural markets by launching a commodity exchange. What will be the impact of such a move? Who will be the winners and the losers? We develop a simple search model to study the impact of introducing a commodity exchange in a village economy where traders and farmers exchange on a bilateral basis. We study the efficiency gains from moving from the status quo to a trading regime where farmers have the option of selling their produce to a commodity exchange. We describe how the gains from trade are distributed between farmers, traders and the commodity exchange itself. We show that a dual economy where high-cost farmers remain in the bilateral exchange market while low-cost ones sell to the commodity exchange can exist in equilibrium, and that forcing all farmers to sell into the commodity exchange can make some farmers worse off.
abstract_zh: 数个非洲国家近来通过设立大宗商品交易所，实现了农产品市场的集中化。这一举措将产生什么影响？谁会成为赢家，谁会成为输家？我们构建了一个简单的搜寻模型，研究在一个村庄经济中引入大宗商品交易所的影响，该村庄中商贩与农民以双边方式进行交易。我们研究了从现状转向农民可选择将农产品出售给大宗商品交易所的交易制度所带来的效率收益。我们描述了贸易收益如何在农民、商贩和交易所本身之间分配。我们表明，一种双重经济可以在均衡中存在：高成本农民留在双边交易市场，而低成本农民则向大宗商品交易所出售；而强制所有农民都向大宗商品交易所出售，则可能使部分农民的境况变差。

title: Trade, Farmers' Heterogeneity, and Agricultural Productivity: Evidence from Colombia
abstract: This paper studies how farmers’ participation in non-local markets shapes agricultural productivity. Using farm-level data from Colombia, we document two empirical patterns about the spatial organization of agriculture. First, across municipalities, better access to urban centers increases farmers’ productivity and participation in non-local markets, but reduces farm size. Second, within municipalities and crop-choices, larger farms participate more in non-local markets and have higher productivity. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce farmers with heterogeneous productivity and market participation choices into a spatial economy model. We take the model to data and find that removing the geographic barriers to farmers’ participation in non-local markets can increase Colombia's agricultural value added by up to 14%. Changes in the productivity composition of farmers contribute substantially to this impact, particularly in remote regions with low participation of farmers in non-local markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究农民参与非本地市场如何塑造农业生产率。利用哥伦比亚的农场层面数据，我们记录了农业空间组织的两个实证规律。第一，在不同市县之间，更便利地进入城市中心会提高农民的生产率和非本地市场参与度，但会减小农场规模。第二，在市县内部以及作物选择之内，规模较大的农场更多地参与非本地市场，且生产率更高。为解释这些规律，我们在空间经济模型中引入了具有异质性生产率和市场参与选择的农民。我们以数据对模型进行估计，发现消除农民参与非本地市场的地理障碍，可使哥伦比亚的农业增加值提高多达14%。农民生产率构成的变化对这一影响贡献显著，在农民非本地市场参与率较低的偏远地区尤为明显。

title: Trade, Productivity, and the Spatial Organization of Agriculture: Evidence from Brazil
abstract: This paper studies how regional productivity shocks in agriculture propagate to the rest of the economy via trade and migration linkages, shaping their aggregate effects on GDP, welfare, and agricultural employment. Using comprehensive agricultural data from Brazil, I estimate a general equilibrium model with a rich spatial structure to evaluate the effects of a critical shock in modern agriculture: the adaptation of soybeans to tropical regions. Results show that this shock increased Brazil’s agricultural GDP by 4%–6%, with the bulk of this impact coming from international trade. Because soybeans are land-intensive relative to other agricultural sectors, agricultural employment fell in tropical regions to which soybeans expanded. In other parts of the economy, however, agricultural employment rose substantially. Additionally, I show that general equilibrium effects have important implications for the analysis of the returns to agricultural research and the evaluation of the reduced-form effects of productivity shocks on agricultural employment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究农业区域生产率冲击如何通过贸易和移民联系传导至经济的其他部门，并塑造其对GDP、福利和农业就业的总体影响。利用巴西全面的农业数据，我估计了一个具有丰富空间结构的一般均衡模型，以评估现代农业中一项关键冲击的效应：大豆向热带地区的适应性扩展。结果显示，该冲击使巴西农业GDP提高了4%–6%，其中大部分影响来自国际贸易。由于大豆相对于其他农业部门属于土地密集型作物，大豆扩张所至的热带地区农业就业有所下降。然而，在经济的其他部分，农业就业则大幅上升。此外，我表明，一般均衡效应对于农业研究回报的分析，以及对生产率冲击对农业就业的简化式效应的评估，都具有重要含义。

title: Patterns and Processes of Pasture to Crop Conversion in Brazil: Evidence from Mato Grosso State
The Impact of a Decade of Agricultural Change on Urban Economic Growth in Mato Grosso, Brazil
